europe_now.title: Russian drone aimed at Ukraine security service HQ
europe_now.summary: A Russian drone was reported to have targeted Ukraine's security service headquarters, according to President Zelensky. The incident raises concerns about security threats against Ukrainian institutions.

sources.headline: Russian drone ‘aimed directly’ at Ukraine security service HQ, Zelensky says

europe_now.title: Wave of Russian sabotage attacks exposes counter-intelligence gaps on Nato’s eastern flank
europe_now.summary: A series of Russian sabotage attacks have been identified on NATO's eastern flank, revealing gaps in counter‑intelligence capabilities. The findings suggest potential vulnerabilities in the alliance's eastern defenses.

sources.headline: Wave of Russian sabotage attacks exposes counter-intelligence gaps on Nato’s eastern flank
